items.html: Behold, we have explained that the concealed Hochma of AA has ten Sefirot in it, and the phase of the Yesod within it is the palate, and it couples with the throat, which is the Bina of the entirety of the Partzuf Arich, and it is the Malchut of the Hochma mentioned as well. And you already know that in every place where there is an entirety of ten Sefirot, there are in them four names, AB, SAG, MA, BON, which are in the Hochma, Bina, Tifferet, and Malchut of those ten Sefirot, and so too in these ten Sefirot of the Hochma mentioned of Arich, there are these four names of AB, SAG, MA, BON.
